Name: Endangered Specimens - Mermaid Mod
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
[center][b]ENDANGERED SPECIMENS  MOD - MERMAID[/b]

[left][b]ENDANGERED SPECIES FOUND IN STARDEW VALLEY! In ancient times, before stardew valley was well...[/b][b] [/b][i][b]stardew valley, [/b][/i]different species ruled the land before any humans. It's not certain what caused the vanishing of these unique creatures but if you're lucky enough, you still have a chance to bring them back to the valley! The sad thing is that there's only one member left of each species. It's your choice to let the last species live or sell it's egg for gold.

[b]HOW TO FIND A MERMAID EGG?:[/b][/left]
[left]You have a 7% chance of catching a "mysterious egg" by fishing in the ses. The egg  radiates a dark siren aura in the dark.

[b]EGG HATCHING AND CARE:[/b]
-2 days after placing the egg into the tank, the egg will hatch into a "baby mermaid".  You need to feed your baby mermaid everyday. It will grow into an adult mermaid in 3 days. You can feed your mermaid [i][b][u]any algae or fish.

[/u][/b][/i]-Adult mermaid produce [u][i][b]a pearl [/b][/i][/u]every day. Occasionaly she can give you [b][i][u]an aquamarine, a treasure chest or an ocean stone[/u][/i][/b] too.

[u][i][b]-Every 50 game days the mermaid gives you a prismatic shard.[/b][/i][/u]

-if you fail to feed your mermaid for more than 5 days your mermaid will die. 

[b]CHEAT SHEET:
[/b]A README.txt file is included in the mod folder of the SMAPI command of spawning another mermaid egg in case it dies or you just want another one. Just remember that each tank can host only one mermaid.

Creator's Note: I will add different species into the game but in the meantime enjoy this mermaid one!

Created by Abrah.

[/left]
[/center]
